title.narrative: Private Sector Development in Mozambique

description.narrative:
The program aims to build a strong foundation for private-sector-driven diversification in Mozambique, particularly in priority economic sectors, and to foster decent job creation by contributing to easier access to markets and/or value chains by the private sector. The program will achieve this by:

¿Developing the enabling conditions for the private sector to invest and operate in Mozambique, through improved policies and regulations and facilitated access to finance, 

¿Leveraging the country¿s rich natural resources for the development of biodiversity-compatible sectors (i.e., regenerative agribusiness, sustainable forestry, fisheries, and nature-based tourism).

We are not able to disaggregate by age here as there is no choice available.We decided to report an accumulative target for end of 2025. The reason is that we will slowly reduce our support for legal aid interventions in 2025. As the project tries to implement sustainable structures in the legal aid sector it will reduce its amount of funding in 2025 substantially to test how sustainable the provision of legal aid in Zambia is. Therefore the numbers for 2025 wil be a lot lower then for the rest of the years. Thus we only report on an accumulative target.
